svg.title: Allocate Startup Capital Before Scaling Outreach
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate Startup Capital Before Scaling Outreach; subtitle: Four buckets total $20,000 within the $5,000–$35,000 range.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values describe one $20,000 startup allocation. Details also provide lean and expanded allocations totaling $5,000 and $35,000 respectively. These are deployment budgets, not projected revenue or sufficient runway for every case. Owner living costs are outside these allocations.; caption: Central allocation: $4,000 + $6,000 + $5,000 + $5,000 = $20,000. A 3–12 month first-deal window requires separate runway planning against actual recurring and variable costs.; stages: label: Jurisdiction and agreement setup; value: $4,000 central allocation for lawful engagement setup; numeric value: 4000.0; detail: Lean allocation $1,000; expanded allocation $7,000. Fund applicable registration, jurisdiction-specific agreement drafting, and focused professional review before purchasing a large prospect inventory.; label: Secure records and workflow; value: $6,000 central allocation for evidence-handling infrastructure; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Lean allocation $1,500; expanded allocation $10,000. Configure Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace access controls, encrypted endpoints, backup restoration tests, and a minimal claim-status database.; label: Research and owner acquisition; value: $5,000 central allocation for measured prospect development; numeric value: 5000.0; detail: Lean allocation $1,000; expanded allocation $8,000. Purchase authorized records, obtain certified entity documents, and test transparent outreach. Track spend per evidence-supported case before increasing volume.; label: Operating liquidity reserve; value: $5,000 central allocation for early cash timing gaps; numeric value: 5000.0; detail: Lean allocation $1,500; expanded allocation $10,000. At $4,000 monthly fixed overhead, the central reserve covers only 1.25 months before variable costs; arrange additional runway or reduce the initial cost structure.
